Project local resource catalog `output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json`, generated 2026-10-27 (catalog source `PROC CONTENTS source catalog`, SHA-256 45894893e45d56cb56150252c2ce4e85dfa88f5d891f3e547d3e9ea8003993fb): catalog lists BoardEx and ISS vendor families but no CFPB or FDIC local product/resource, and does not identify a producer for an updated Table 6 event panel. This metadata snapshot does not establish public-source coverage outside the catalog.

Accepted `t1_to_t6.do` source and paper text pages cited per analysis row; prior native evidence in `output/executions/packages/jar-3ce6c4afbc70/report.json` and local input hashes in `output/executions/packages/jar-3ce6c4afbc70/local_inputs.json`.
changes: Both assigned scopes use their source-defined January 2012–February 2020 end; the five-calendar-year requested endpoint is 2025-02.

No estimator, code, input path, or sample window was changed and no scientific run was launched: both assignments are no_added_observations at preflight because later months violate the pre-COVID cutoff or fixed event-year -1/0/+1 window.
limitations: The task exposes only sample ID `baseline` for Table 4. It does not define sample IDs for the independently assigned Table 2 Panel B or Table 6 rows, so sample_ids are empty rather than mislinking those analyses to Table 4.

Table 6’s published design starts January 2012 and ends February 2020, while the accepted fitted panel starts January 2013 and ends December 2019. This observed-coverage discrepancy is documented; the input contains no later admissible event-window observations.

No current-vintage CFPB raw file or later FDIC SOD raw files were verified in the project catalog or accepted package; no download, substitute source, or new panel construction was used. The fixed sample designs independently rule out using post-February-2020 months for these assigned scopes.

Prior native limitations retained: T6 reported collinearity notes and source replacement of missing delta_div_size values with zero; T2 emitted legacy merge and nonunique ZIP3/year warnings and each fit dropped two singleton observations. The prior report did not assess agreement with reference values for the T2 fits.
The controller carries all five predecessor scope gaps into the final report under prior_gaps.

analyses.label: Table 6, column (1): change in diverse directors × post × Nonwhite
analyses.reason: Preflight disposition: no later observations are admissible under the retained event-study design. The paper’s section 4.4 and Table 6 use a fixed pre-pandemic window and include only event years -1, 0, and +1 around the selected 2014, 2017, and 2018 director-departure cohorts. The accepted panel’s yearmonth_U clock runs 201301–201912; aggregate reconstruction of eventtime = floor(yearmonth_U/100) - floor(yearmonth/100) finds 76,740 rows at -1, 76,740 at 0, 73,296 at +1, and zero outside those three periods. The last admissible observation is 2019-12, the +1 year for the 2018 cohort. Extending later would change the event window or require new events, matching, and a panel producer that are not present in the accepted construction. The paper’s stated January 2012–February 2020 window exceeds the accepted panel’s actual 2013-01–2019-12 coverage; that discrepancy is retained. No scientific replay was launched on unchanged historical data. The focal treatment is the source-recoded sign of d_treat72.

prior_gaps.description: T1 main-sample summary (source lines 137-141) and T2 Panel A main-sample fits (179-180) are blocked upstream: root metadata review confirms the prepared inputs do not contain source-used population at lines 121-122. population_zip3 exists, but no denominator substitution is approved because the source multiplier’s units are unresolved. The T2 Panel B stage includes only the T1 Panel B summary subset at line 380; Table 1 overall remains incomplete.

Gallup T1 summary and T2 Panel A columns 3-4 (source lines 182-358) are also blocked by the same undefined population references at lines 121-122. The source-linked unemployment_zip30601 product is not aliased or used; its residual vintage uncertainty is not a separate blocker because the branch cannot reach it without an approved population repair.

T3 Panels A/B and their firm-level T1 Panel C summaries are omitted. The separate firmsize input is required at source line 404, but its fiscal-year/datadate row selection and one-row-per-gvkey producer contract remain unresolved; no raw Compustat reconstruction was attempted.

T4 Panels A/B and related T1 Panel C summaries are omitted. The exact company_zip_month_unemploy20220601.dta input and d_post_ne_priunemploy2019h1_0601 construction remain unverified; the base panel’s similarly named field was not substituted.
T5 and its IDV-related T1 Panel C summary are omitted. IDVdata.dta is absent/restricted and its full panel keys/fields and authorized route remain unresolved; T5 also depends on the T4 panel.
